purpose: Evidence-traceable behavioural closure candidates layered on the immutable Accounting Spine and structural Dynamic Core.

activation_semantics.ACTIVATED: admitted to a currently open calibration/validation cycle; not validated, not quantitatively active in the System Dynamics reference simulation, and removable/downgradable when the frozen evaluation disposition closes that cycle
activation_semantics.CANDIDATE: implemented/documented for testing but excluded from the central calibrated model until its evidence and identifiability gates pass
activation_semantics.DEFERRED: not numerically active because observability, identification or scope is insufficient
activation_semantics.REJECTED: form excluded because it is structurally/causally under-specified or contradicted by the modelling contract

central_calibration_rule: No behavioural mechanism is currently in an open central calibration cycle. Future admission requires a newly declared calibration/validation cycle with frozen selection/evaluation boundaries; CANDIDATE or DEFERRED mechanisms may not drive the reference simulation.
parameter_rule: No coefficient has a convenience default. Parameters are either observed/data-derived with provenance, externally sourced with explicit transferability limits, or estimated under the declared calibration protocol.
observability_rule: Every admitted mechanism must list target and driver observables or be downgraded/deferred.
causality_rule: Predictive/associational fit is not sufficient to label a coefficient causal. Policy/endogeneity-sensitive mechanisms remain explicitly qualified.

data_frequency_policy.monthly: preferred for monetary pass-through and financial-market observables when definitions are stable
data_frequency_policy.quarterly: preferred for national accounts, Flow-of-Funds and real-economy mechanisms
data_frequency_policy.mixed_frequency: aggregation/alignment must be predeclared within each evaluation origin to avoid future-information leakage

next_stage.name: Prospective Confirmation / Reference-Mode Data Recovery
next_stage.holdout_rule: An inspected evaluation holdout cannot subsequently be reported as independent validation. The frozen household form may be tested on prospectively reserved observations only under its existing no-respecification rule.
current_priorities: preserve 2026-08 onward monetary observations for the first genuinely identifying new policy-rate episode
do not reopen government repricing estimation until matched instrument-level principal and old/new rate evidence satisfy the frozen ledger gates
materialize missing reference modes before integrated behavioural closure is reconsidered

post_validation_disposition.rule: The frozen validation-recovery disposition governs current mechanism status. Pre-recovery admission to calibration does not survive as ACTIVATED after the evaluation cycle closes unless the disposition explicitly authorizes it.
